thread:
Maria (oncall): Heads up — we're seeing a spike in TLS handshake failures (502 / connection resets) targeting hosted-api since ~12:05 UTC. Correlated with the scheduled cert rotation job. Opening incident page: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/1934567890. Investigating now.
SRE Bot: Alert: TLS handshake error rate > 5% (service: hosted-api, region: us-west) — graph: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/tls-errors?from=now-15m
Jake (infra): Confirmed rotation job kicked off at 12:03 via cert-manager v0.20. New cert chain pushed to edge LB. Rolling back rotation now to previous cert to stop new connections using the chain.
Sophie (support): CS update: we have ~7 customer reports so far, two are paying enterprise accounts (acct: AcmeCorp, OmniRetail). Raising priority on their tickets.
Leo (eng-runtime): Noted some older clients reject the new chain due to an unexpected SAN ordering change. If rollback doesn't cut it, we can add compatibility header in runtime but prefer rollback first.
Maria (oncall): Mitigation step: disabled scheduled cert rotation across all regions, initiating rollback to last-known-good cert on edge nodes. ETA for rollback propagation: ~10 min. Please avoid manual restarts of gateways while rollback propagates.
Amanda (product): I'll draft a short external status message for status.redwood.ai and pings for the customer success team. Suggested blurb: "We experienced transient TLS connection failures affecting a subset of hosted API customers; mitigation in progress."
Support Bot: Created support incident INC-2026-972 and attached extracted connection logs. Tickets linked: #2343, #2344, #2345.
Jake (infra): Rollback completed in us-west at 12:18 UTC, eu-west rollback started 12:19 UTC. Monitoring shows handshake errors in us-west dropping to baseline by 12:22.
Sophie (support): Sent targeted updates to the two enterprise contacts and updated their tickets with temporary mitigation steps (retry/backoff).
Maria (oncall): Status update: majority of traffic healthy now, overall error rate back to baseline in us-west, eu-west finishing rollback. Root cause preliminary: cert-manager template introduced an extra SAN entry ordering that some legacy client TLS stacks reject.
Maria (oncall): Next steps: full postmortem scheduled within 24h. Immediate action items: pin cert-manager version used by rotation job, add a canary rotation path (1% traffic) and an automated rollback trigger on TLS error rate. I'll put the action list on the incident page: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/1934567890/postmortem.
Amanda (product): Thanks — I'll coordinate the customer-facing note once postmortem draft is ready.
Leo (eng-runtime): Logging follow-up: capturing client TLS version and cipher suites to confirm affected clients. Will attach to incident doc.
Maria (oncall): Marking incident as mitigated for now. If you see any residual spikes, @here please ping this thread. :white_check_mark:
